cleansingStrength.rationale: `low` by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is Cocamidopropyl Betaine@2 (amphoteric). Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate@3 (sulfosuccinate), Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate@4 (isethionate) and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate@9 (sarcosinate) are mild anionics (C3). Coco-Glucoside@14 is after the E3 point. Confidence moderate: three prominent mild anionics directly behind the betaine are a substantial anionic load, and the betaine leads only by list order, so realistic unknowns could make the net architecture `moderate` (counter-signal; it does not move the C6 value).

conditioningLevel.rationale: `high` via the Section 5 rich-architecture route: W-RICH for conditioning (E3 reading) — prominent payload lipid Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil@11 converging with a cationic system (Polyquaternium-10@13, Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@20, Polyquaternium-7@21, Polyquaternium-11@22); plus weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate@15 and humectant Glycerin@26. C2 itself is uncertain (no pearlizing/fatty route besides the oil). Confidence moderate: the coconut oil sits after Phenoxyethanol@7 and Sodium Benzoate@10 and all four cationic polymers are after the fragrance marker, so dose unknowns could leave several light routes (`moderate`).
